# AI Smartr

> AI Smartr is a full-service AI automation company. We build custom workflows, AI agents, integrations, fine-tuned models, and AI apps for professionals, small businesses, and mid-market companies. We save businesses time, money, and headaches by replacing manual bottlenecks with automated systems.

## Who We Are

AI Smartr serves independent professionals (lawyers, consultants, advisors), small businesses (1 to 50 employees), and mid-market companies (51 to 500 employees). We design, build, deploy, and manage AI solutions end to end, so you get one partner instead of a one-time vendor.

Contact: derek@aismartr.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ai-smartr/
Website: https://aismartr.com

## Services

- **Workflow Automation**: Pipelines built around your specific processes. Lead follow-up, client onboarding, billing, reporting, approvals, and task routing.

- **AI Agents**: Always-on agents that reason, plan, and act. Customer service, sales, research, and scheduling agents, plus multi-agent systems with approval gates and audit logging.

- **Integrations**: AI connected to the tools you already use. CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive), email (Gmail, Outlook), chat (Slack, Teams, WhatsApp), project management (Monday, Asana, Notion, Linear), and custom APIs.

- **Fine-Tuned Models**: Models trained on your data for domain-specific accuracy. Document understanding, sentiment analysis, classification, and industry-specific language.

- **AI Apps**: Purpose-built applications. Internal tools, client portals, document processors, and reporting dashboards.

## What Clients Get

- Time: clients typically reclaim 10 to 30+ hours per week
- Money: 24/7 systems cut operating costs
- Revenue: faster lead response and consistent follow-up feed the sales pipeline
- Fewer bottlenecks: each build targets the specific friction points in your business

## Who Should Use AI Smartr

- Independent professionals who want client intake, scheduling, document drafting, and follow-up handled
- Small businesses that need sales automation, customer service agents, and operational workflows
- Mid-market companies rolling AI out across departments with custom apps and fine-tuned models

## Process

1. Free 30-minute discovery consultation to find the highest-value AI opportunities
2. Solution architecture scoped to your goals, budget, and existing tech stack
3. Build and integration, with most implementations live within one week
4. Ongoing monitoring, optimization, and support
